attchmntText: Anmol India Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Anmol India Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 13 November 2026. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 721.29 Crore. Profit before tax stood at 12.39 Crore. Net profit was 9.27 Crore. Earnings per share were 1.63. Total assets were 387.99 Crore. Total equity was 127.52 Crore. The statutory auditors completed a limited review and issued an unmodified report.
